title.en: An Act Authorizing the Secretary of Justice to Purchase the Original of Dr. Jose Rizal'S "El Filibusterismo," and Making the Necessary Appropriation for this Purpose

text.en:
The Secretary of Justice is hereby authorized to purchase the original of Dr. Jose Rizal's novel
"El Filibusterismo," to be deposited in the Philippine Library and Museum, as property of the Insular
Government.

The sum of ten thousand pesos is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the Insular Treasury
not otherwise appropriated, to be disbursed in its entirety or so much thereof as may be necessary, in the
discretion of the Secretary of Justice, for the purchase of the original of "El Filibusterismo."

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 27, 1925.
